conflicts.permit: With User's opt-in consent, the AAA Mobile App may use the location data to send information related to AAA discounts available nearby via push notifications to the User's device.
conflicts.prohibit: After your roadside assistance service request has been closed, your current location will no longer be shared with or visible to the roadside assistance provider or us.
conflicts.situation: Accessing or using a user's current location to provide nearby discount notifications after a roadside assistance request has been closed.
conflicts.reason: One clause explicitly states AAA ('us') will no longer have visibility of current location after closing a service request, conflicting with ongoing background location use for nearby discounts.
